rules.description: Do not state that software or a deployment is GDPR or FADP compliant.
rules.guidance: Describe tested technical behaviour and leave legal conclusions to the controller.

rules.description: Do not claim GDPR or FADP certification.
rules.guidance: State that Masterplan does not provide legal certification.

rules.description: Do not claim software proves or guarantees physical deletion of every copy.
rules.guidance: Distinguish signed workflow evidence from physical deletion outside the controlled system.

rules.description: Do not make an unscoped claim that a service handles no personal data.
rules.guidance: Name the exact technical scope and identify hosting or controller facts that remain external.

rules.description: Do not state blanket national or regional data residency without controller evidence.
rules.guidance: Report configured storage and support-access countries as controller-confirmed facts.

rules.description: Do not make an absolute claim that data never leaves a device, country or deployment.
rules.guidance: Describe the bounded flow and any provider, backup or support path.

rules.description: Do not make absolute named-provider access or processing claims.
rules.guidance: Use controller-confirmed provider facts and narrowly describe protocol behaviour.

rules.description: Do not describe operational data or logs as fully anonymous.
rules.guidance: Use pseudonymous or de-identified only when the exact transformation is documented.

rules.description: Software cannot establish a controller legal basis.
rules.guidance: Record legal-basis fields as controller decisions, not software findings.
